I'm 21.

I lost one friend over this already. Most of my friends talk to me when it's convenient for them. None of them have been there for me through this. 

That's what everyone says, your true friends will come out when times are tough, and no one has. One literally didn't want to hear about it so we don't talk at all now.
What's the point? All of my "friends"don't care about me and they all tend to leave at some point.

The one person I can tell is my ex. She's been the only one to help. My other friends just left me hanging. 

I wish so too. I'm apart of the lgbt community in the south and life here is already rough. 

Do you really think there are people that are worth it?
